requirement_text: If offering an equal product, the quote must clearly identify it by brand name and make/model number, include descriptive literature (illustrations, drawings, or a clear reference to previously furnished data), and clearly describe any modifications needed to conform to the solicitation.

evidence.quote:
Manufacturer: Veridian MedTech.
Part Number: HC-4H-2026.

Equivalent Brand: HydroClear
Equivalent Nomenclature: HydroClear Pro 4H Waterline Delivery System
Equivalent Part Number: HC-4H-2026
Equivalent Description Matching Salient Characteristics: air-driven
high-speed 4-hole handpiece system compatible with Midwest-style
connections, with a sterile irrigation pathway and autoclavable
components; see technical description below for full comparison.

Technical Description: The HydroClear Pro 4H is an air-driven, high
speed (4-hole) system fitting Midwest 4-hole handpieces, using
autoclavable tubing for a sterile delivery pathway and (2) 8 ounce
autoclavable bottles. The full unit is autoclavable to ensure
sterility between uses, and it is designed to provide high-speed
cutting power rivaling electric handpieces while maintaining
precision and responsiveness. Irrigation is controlled with a simple
instant on/off mechanism and no added footprint. Note: the HydroClear
Pro 4H utilizes a fixed, non-detachable waterline routing integrated
into the handpiece body, rather than a detachable waterline system.

reasoning: The bidder is offering an equal product (HydroClear Pro 4H) and clearly identifies it by brand name, make/model, and part number (Veridian MedTech, HC-4H-2026). They also include descriptive technical literature and a description of modifications/differences such as the fixed, non-detachable waterline routing.
